Package frc.robot.subsystems.turret

Class TurretIO.TurretIOInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.turret.TurretIO.TurretIOInputs
Enclosing interface:
TurretIO
public static class TurretIO.TurretIOInputs extends Object
Mutable snapshot of all turret sensor readings, refreshed each loop by TurretIO.updateInputs(TurretIOInputs).

Fields are public and mutable by design â€” the IO implementation writes into this object and the subsystem reads from it, avoiding allocations every loop.

All hardware telemetry is registered with OnboardLogger in the constructor so that every field is automatically published to SmartDashboard / NT4 without additional put* calls in periodic().

  • Field Details

    • motorConnected

      public boolean motorConnected
      True when the TalonFX responds on CAN. False after a CAN fault or motor disconnect.

    • calibrated

      public boolean calibrated
      True after TurretIO.calibrate() has been called and the encoder has been zeroed. The turret should not track a field target until this is true.

    • voltage

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Voltage voltage
      Motor supply voltage (battery-side, before internal resistance drop).

    • supplyCurrent

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Current supplyCurrent
      Supply current drawn from the battery (includes quiescent draw of the TalonFX).

    • statorCurrent

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Current statorCurrent
      Stator (motor-side) current. Proportional to torque output. High stator current with low velocity â†’ near stall (mechanism hitting a hard stop).

    • torqueCurrent

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Current torqueCurrent
      Torque current â€” the component of stator current doing useful work (torque-producing). Excludes magnetizing/reactive current. Useful for characterizing mechanism friction.

    • temperature

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Temperature temperature
      Motor winding temperature. TalonFX thermal limit is ~85 Â°C â€” log this to catch thermal issues.

    • velocity

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.AngularVelocity velocity
      Mechanism angular velocity (revolutions per second of the turret ring, not the motor shaft).

    • reference

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Angle reference
      Current MotionMagic position reference (what the controller is currently commanding toward). In mechanism rotations. Comparing this to position shows tracking error.

    • position

      public edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Angle position
      Actual mechanism position from the CANcoder absolute encoder, in radians / rotations.
